title: Arhitektura cloud aplikacija i IAM
summary: Dopunske komponente (WAF, DAM, XML firewall, API gateway, load balancer), kriptografija i sandboxing u cloud aplikacijama, mikroservisi, kontejneri i Kubernetes, te dizajn IAM-a: IdP, federacija (SAML, OAuth, OIDC), SSO, MFA, CASB i upravljanje tajnama, ključevima i certifikatima.
summary_en: Supplemental components (WAF, DAM, XML firewall, API gateway, load balancer), cryptography and sandboxing in cloud applications, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes, and IAM design: IdP, federation (SAML, OAuth, OIDC), SSO, MFA, CASB, and secrets, key, and certificate management.
